name: Volume Profile with POC
note: Buckets each 5m bar's volume into 5-cent price bins weighted toward the bar's typical price, then grows the 70% value area out from the point of control one adjacent bin at a time, with a keyboard price cursor reading buy/sell split per level.
html:
NVDA XNAS · 5m · 09:30–12:00 · 5¢ bins
value area 70% sell buy ↑↓ lvl · PgUp/Dn ±5 · Home POC

name: Anchored VWAP Sigma Bands
note: Recomputes a volume-weighted mean and volume-weighted standard deviation of typical price from any anchor bar (open, low, high or the cursor via Enter), drawing the 1 and 2 sigma envelopes and proving AVWAP as cumulative notional over cumulative volume.
html: META XNAS · 5m · AVWAP ±1/2σ

name: Footprint Cluster Chart
note: A price-by-bar CSS grid of bid x ask volume that flags diagonal imbalances (ask at a price against bid one tick lower, 300% with a 20-lot floor), outlines each bar's POC, detects stacked runs and switches cells between bid/ask, delta and volume.
html:
ESZ6 CME · 5m footprint · 0.25 = $12.50
buy imb ≥300% diag sell imb bar POC ←→ bar · B D V

name: CVD Divergence Monitor
note: A self-stopping requestAnimationFrame feed builds 1m bars and session cumulative volume delta, finds 3-bar swing pivots in price and compares them to CVD at the same bars to flag higher-high/lower-CVD bearish and lower-low/higher-CVD bullish divergences.
html:
CLX6 NYMEX · 1m · CVD
swing = 3-bar pivot · CVD = Σ(ask-lifted − bid-hit) since 18:00 ET · SPACE pause

name: Aggressor Pressure Split
note: Splits each symbol's volume into ask-lifted, bid-hit and unclassified mid prints with largest-remainder rounding so every bar sums to exactly 100, sorts by net pressure and drills into notional size buckets whose shares reconcile to the row totals.
html:
AGGRESSOR SPLIT quote rule vs NBBO
SYMBUY · MID · SELL %NET ΔB/S
↑↓ symbol · ←→ window · sorted by net pressure (B−S)/(B+S) · mid prints unclassified

name: Relative Volume Scanner
note: Divides each name's volume by ADV20 times the cumulative intraday volume curve to 11:45, draws a 0-3x gauge with 1x and 2x rules, sorts by key or header and plots the selected name's cumulative path against the expected curve with a curve-based close projection.
html:
RVOL SCAN 11:45 ET · time-of-day adjusted · ADV20
EXP1×2×3×
RVOL = VOL / (ADV20 × cum. curve to now) · ↑↓ row · R V S sort

name: Block Print Overlay
note: Overlays block prints on a 2m price line as bubbles with radius proportional to the square root of notional, fill encoding aggressor side and a dashed stroke for off-exchange TRF prints, with a threshold filter and a pulsing ring on the keyboard-selected print.
html:
MSFT blocks · 2m · 09:30–12:30 ET
buy ≥asksell ≤bidmidoff-exch TRF←→ print · 1 2 3

name: Intraday Volume Curve Schedule
note: Plots today's half-hour share of ADV against the 20-day U-shaped curve with the closing cross split out, then allocates a VWAP parent order across the curve by largest remainder and reconciles fills, POV and slippage against interval VWAP.
html:
AMZN 30m vol curve · 13:10 ET BUY 250,000 · VWAP
20d avg %today % ADV≥1.2× avgour fills←→ bucket · Home/End
